title: Kraken Trade Trade Volume Leaderboard
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kraken:trade volume_usd=*
| stats sum(volume_usd) as total_value, avg(volume_usd) as avg_value by pair
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks pair values by total and average trade volume across Kraken trade events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `volume_usd` values for each Kraken trade event and review total and average trade volume by pair.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total trade volume.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises which pair shows the biggest trade volume numbers in your Kraken trade data.
